payload.summary: Planned add-skill-audit: a recurring, evidence-joined audit of SKILL.md files by layer (contract / constraint / procedure / teaching) with a roster-driven dispatch profile, a memory-to-tier evidence join, a stamped report, and candidate-work stubs, plus an optional procedure_mode field on archetypes injected at coordinator resolution. Coordinated tier (all capabilities present); planning ran in the cloud checkout because the designated branch was already checked out there. Gate 1 approved Approach 1; Gate 2 pending.

decisions.title: Position as a recurring audit over the skill-rightsizing substrates, not a roadmap item
decisions.rationale: Roadmap items ri-01..ri-20 are all candidate at 0/10; the roster rotated twice in a month; the audit consumes their outputs when present and degrades until then.

decisions.title: v1 is static classification plus evidence join; no benchmark runs
decisions.rationale: Runs belong to add-harbor-benchmark-routing (combo sweep) or packages/agent-scenarios; the findings schema reserves evidence.benchmark for them.

decisions.title: procedure_mode is an optional field on the archetype, injected only in resolve_archetype_for_phase
decisions.rationale: The tier is known there and nowhere else; the autopilot fold forwards system_prompt verbatim; the review dispatcher never composes an archetype prompt; guided default keeps output byte-identical.

decisions.title: Rightsizing conventions are canonical for the audit's lint; --convention current remains during the transition
decisions.rationale: rewrite-skill-frontmatter and delete-rationalizations-relax-tail-block define the target shape; add-product-management-skills is flagged as needing rebase.

decisions.title: Deterministic pre-pass first, at most one batched analyst call per skill, invalid output labels unclassified
decisions.rationale: Makes determinism and cost NFRs testable without an LLM in CI and mirrors the audit_triage strict-schema posture.

decisions.title: Gate 1 selection: Approach 1 (standalone skill + procedure_mode)
decisions.rationale: User selected the recommended approach on 2026-09-15 after four discovery answers, all on the recommended option.

next_steps: Gate 2 approval, then /implement-feature add-skill-audit; wp-procedure-mode and wp-skill-audit run in parallel, wp-integration last.
First audits: merge-pull-requests, validate-feature, and the four teaching-heavy skills.
